reference_answer: The researchers obtained informed consent before the interviews. Specifically, the account includes an interest-free overdraft subject to a limit. These concrete observations clarify the operational scope of the method without overstating its generality.
acceptable_alternatives: Rather than relying on unverified claims, the analysis specifies concrete procedures: The researchers obtained informed consent before the interviews. Meanwhile, the account includes an interest-free overdraft subject to a limit.
explanation_zh:
本题考查【根治只有夸张而无实例/指标的写作病灶（Rule G033/G028）】。
地道学术写作从不说 *extremely great / solves all problems*，而是用具体操作与边界说话：
- 第 1 句用“informed consent”（The researchers obtained informed consent before the interviews.）给出具体研究事实或操作定义；
- 第 2 句用“interest-free overdraft”（The account includes an interest-free overdraft subject to a limit.）补充具体测量、分布或样本条件；
- 第 3 句收束于受控范围，实现“主张—具体机制—实证边界”的严密闭环。
